title: OWNER_CONTAINER_PREP_APPROVAL -- the first signature of the two-signature gate
description: Owner audit 2026-08-31 section 3 (two-signature gate). This record authorizes ONLY: downloading and identity-pinning the frozen base model (revision SHA, weight digests, tokenizer digest), building the execution container (image digest, dependency lock), and constructing + digest-pinning the alternative-taxonomy table. It authorizes NO training, NO activation extraction, NO protected read, NO claim-bearing run. The identities it produces are then written into the GATE_1B_EXECUTION record (OWNER_PHASE_APPROVAL.schema.json v2), which the owner signs SECOND -- so nothing is deferred past the execution signature. Verified by tools/verify_phase_approval.py verify_container_prep(): same canonical signing bytes, same pinned-public-key law, same commit and tree binding.
